scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @cpj/api" "npm run dev -w @cpj/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cpj/contracts && npm run build -w @cpj/api && npm run build -w @cpj/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cpj/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cpj/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
